name: Riobamba

queries.query: Riobamba Ecuador official cadastral map parcel GIS catastro
queries.result: Official GAD Municipal de Riobamba cadastral-services pages and a public ArcGIS FeatureServer for Predios Urbanos were found. The public service returned parcel polygons with safe system FID identifiers through the national ArcGIS hosting domain.

queries.query: Riobamba Ecuador catastro predios mapa oficial GAD municipal
queries.result: The official municipal Avalúos y Catastros, Ordenamiento Territorial, Geoportal and Registro de la Propiedad pages were found. The municipal pages identify local cadastral and property-registry custodians; the public parcel vector is published through the GAD-attributed ArcGIS service.

officialSourceAssessment.localCustodian: Gobierno Autónomo Descentralizado Municipal del Cantón Riobamba, Dirección de Gestión de Ordenamiento Territorial / Avalúos y Catastros, is the evidenced local cadastral custodian. Registro de la Propiedad de Riobamba is a separate local legal-property registry and was not used for parcel geometry.
regionalOrNationalSources: ArcGIS Online hosting services9.arcgis.com; the layer copyright and description attribute the parcel dataset to the GAD Riobamba Departamento de Ordenamiento Territorial and Catálogo de datos abiertos 2022.
officialSourceAssessment.registryEvidence: Local municipal cadastral responsibilities and a municipal-attributed public parcel layer were evidenced; this does not imply title/ownership data was requested or retained.

requestOutcomes: TLS-verified anonymous GETs retrieved layer metadata and bounded query responses. The exact WUP point was transformed only for testing to EPSG:32717 and EPSG:3857; it returned zero intersecting features in the urban view and was not treated as absence. The broader municipal layer returned three full polygons in a 4 km square around the WUP point, with only FID requested. No credentials, unsafe fields, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or TLS exception was used.
